summary: Tested Halloween effects toggle on /cementerio: corner webs, flying critters (bat/moth wavy flight), toggle ON/OFF hides all effects, localStorage persistence across reloads, cards remain clickable in both states, no console errors, canopy spans full width.
critical_code_review_comments: Cementerio.jsx is ~660 lines with many inline sub-components (DinoCard, ProfileModal, BuyModal, etc). Consider splitting into separate files under /components/cemetery/ for maintainability.
CornerWeb sizes 130-150px are decorative-fine; z-0 keeps them below content — good. pointer-events-none verified via non-blocking card clicks in ON state.
FlyingCritters uses fixed positioning (z-[59]) and correctly avoids blocking interactions.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo account (Probar cuenta demo). 12 cemetery records present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 Halloween features validated on /cementerio: (1) 4 fixed corner spiderweb SVGs render, subtle and pointer-events-none; no horizontal scrollbar. (2) FlyingCritters spawn at ~14s with wavy trajectory (both x AND y change, opacity>0, z-index 59, pointer-events:none) — bat/moth verified. (3) halloween-toggle switches label ON/OFF, wipes vine canopy/corner webs/spiders/critters/card corner vines, persists via localStorage 'cem_halloween'. Cards clickable in both states, canopy spans full viewport width, zero console errors.
